objective: Verify the error-status model of the future candidate.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the entry point and host error paths.
pass_condition: Pass iff kernel-side failures are host-observable, the kernel returns no direct status, and no odata element encodes status.
setup: Inspect the candidate kernel return type, host wrapper return/error propagation, and any odata status convention.
